key.name: show-battery-in-panel
key.description: Display the lowest earbud battery percentage directly in the top panel.

key.name: show-anc-in-panel
key.description: Display the current ANC mode text next to the icon in the Quick Settings toggle.

key.name: enable-battery-notifications
key.description: Notify when earbud battery drops below 20%.

key.name: preferred-device-address
key.description: Bluetooth MAC address of the preferred Nothing/CMF device to connect to.

key.name: rfcomm-channel
key.description: Bluetooth RFCOMM channel (0 for auto-discovery, or specify 15/3/etc).
